description: Agent variants compared by iterate.py. Each changes one thing from the previous one, so a metric change can be attributed.

variants.name: v1-local-baseline
variants.change: Initial agent: local Strands tools, prompt v1, no guardrail

variants.name: v2-local-prompt-v2
variants.change: Prompt v2: scope/safety rules, 'right now in <town>' recipe, no cross-forecast field copying

variants.name: v3-gateway
variants.change: Tools served from AgentCore Gateway (MCP, SigV4) -> Lambda instead of in-process

variants.name: v4-gateway-guardrail
variants.change: Bedrock Guardrail attached to the model (content filters, prompt attack, denied topics, PII)

variants.name: v4-local-guardrail
variants.change: Same as v4 but with local tools; used for replay datasets (the Gateway Lambda only reads live NEA data)

variants.name: v5-local-prompt-v3
variants.change: Prompt v3: don't volunteer haze causes (the replay judge flagged them as unsupported)

variants.name: v5-local-guardrail
variants.change: Prompt v3 + guardrail v3 (narrowed MedicalTreatment topic), local tools for replay datasets

variants.name: v5-gateway-guardrail
variants.change: Prompt v3 + guardrail v3 (narrowed MedicalTreatment topic) via Gateway
